description: Download two beautiful free Urdu Nastaliq fonts — Noto Nastaliq Urdu and Gulzar — licensed under the SIL Open Font License, with a live Urdu text preview.

faqs.a: Noto Nastaliq Urdu and Gulzar are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows free personal and commercial use, embedding in apps and websites, and redistribution. Read the full license in the License section on the page.
faqs.q: Are these fonts free for commercial use?

faqs.a: Jameel Noori Nastaleeq is a paid/commercial font and is not included here. Noto Nastaliq Urdu and Gulzar are free OFL alternatives that look very similar and cover the same Nastaliq style.

Download the .ttf file, then double-click it and press Install (Windows/Mac). On Android, open the file with a font-installer app or place it in your design app's font folder; on iPhone, install it through a font-management app.
faqs.q: How do I install the downloaded font?

howto: Type Urdu text in the live preview box to see it in both fonts.
Click Download Font under the style you like to save the .ttf file.
Double-click the downloaded file to install it on your device.
Use the installed font in Word, Photoshop, Canva or any app.
title: Urdu Fonts
